title: Pepe's Forge
description: Plugin adding custom weapons & tools with unique mechanics: Katana, Scythe, Greatsword, Chisel, Bow, Spear, and Shield.
body:
# Pepe's Forge ## Pepe's Forge is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly Minecraft server plugin that introduces unique custom weapons and specialized tools. ![Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3001a5fac22bcee3564c7975a15829be8c6bb166.png)
## ⚔️ Custom Weapons & Tools Every item in Pepe's Forge introduces a unique mechanic or utility, shifting how players fight and farm. Click on any item below to expand its details:
🪚 Chisel – Block Cycler Tool for builders. Right-click to cycle supported blocks through their decorative variants (Sneak + right-click to cycle backward).
🌾 Scythes (Iron/Dia/Neth) – Area Harvest The ultimate farming tool. Automatically harvests and replants ripe crops in an area (from 3x3 up to 7x7 depending on tier) in a single click.
🌬️ Wind Blades (Iron/Dia/Neth) – Speed & Dash High-mobility weapons. Grants a passive speed boost while held, speed bursts on hit, and a right-click dash ability (5-second cooldown).
🏰 Greatswords (Iron/Dia/Neth) – Two-Handed Rhythm A heavy two-handed sword. Time your swings rhythmically to build momentum, unlocking wide sweeping attacks, bonus damage to nearby enemies, and a frontal shield deflection. *Requires your off-hand to be empty.*
🗡️ Katana – Parry & Reflect A high-skill defensive sword. Right-click at the perfect moment to block incoming melee attacks and reflect arrows or other projectiles back at attackers. *Requires your off-hand to be empty.*
🏹 Crescent Bow – Spread Volley A moon-themed bow that fires a 3-arrow horizontal spread volley while consuming only 1 arrow. Deals less damage during the day, but gains +2 bonus damage under the open night sky.
🔱 Crescent Spear – Rapid Combo Strikes A combo weapon. Land hits to charge your spear; at 100%, your next attack triggers 3 rapid follow-up strikes. Deals bonus damage under the open night sky.
☀️ Solar Shield – Sun-Charged Counter A legendary defensive shield. Automatically charges up to 3 times while held in direct sunlight. Blocking a hit consumes a charge to ignite your attacker and blind them with a solar flashbang.
🩸 Crimson Sword – Combat Progression & Lifesteal A legendary sword that levels up through combat. Feeding on enemies increases its damage, grants passive lifesteal, and unlocks a blood-draining aura.

📌 **All custom weapons, tools, and mechanics are designed to strictly respect land claims and anti-grief protections.** 📂 **Looking for Crafting Recipes and Command IDs?** Check out the comprehensive [ITEMS.md guide on GitHub](https://github.com/mazurpiotr/pepeforge/blob/main/ITEMS.md) for full technical details! --- ## 💾 Installation 1. Download the latest `pepeforge-X.Y.Z.jar`. 2. Drop it into your server's `plugins/` folder. 3. Restart the server to generate configurations. 4. Set up the Resource Pack (see below) and play! --- ## 🎨 Resource Pack & Language Since version 1.2.0, Pepe's Forge uses Minecraft's modern model system. It is compatible with most Minecraft plugin server engines (Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Folia, etc.) on version 1.21.11+. * **Mandatory Resource Pack:** Players **must** have the resource pack loaded. Because custom items use a dedicated visual namespace, they will render as purple-black missing texture cubes without it. * **📥 Download Resource Pack:** Get the resource pack ZIP from the latest release assets on **[Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/project/8BxNWOVt/version/LyvZcPDZ)** or **[GitHub](https://github.com/mazurpiotr/pepeforge/releases)**. * **Paper / Purpur / Folia (Client-side translation):** Item names and descriptions automatically match each player's Minecraft client language. *Note: If you do not have the resource pack loaded on Paper, text will show up as raw translation keys (like `item.pepeforge.katana.name`).* * **Spigot / CraftBukkit (Server-side translation):** Item names and descriptions will display directly in the server's default language (defined in configurations), even if a player does not have the resource pack loaded. --- ## 🔄 Updates & Configuration * **Updates are safe:** When updating from older versions, all existing items in chests and inventories will be automatically updated on the fly. * **Configurable:** Edit `plugins/PepeForge/config.yml` to toggle specific items, disable recipes, or customize language settings. --- ## 💻 Commands | Command | Description | Permission | Default | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/pepeforge items` | Opens an in-game GUI menu to preview all items. | `pepeforge.items` | OP | | `/pepeforge give ` | Gives a specific custom item to a player. | `pepeforge.give` | OP | | `/pepeforge setlevel ` | Sets the level of the Crimson Sword in hand. | `pepeforge.setlevel` | OP | --- ## ❓ FAQ **Q: Will my items break when I update the plugin?** A: No! The plugin automatically modernizes existing items on the fly. **Q: Does client-side translation work on Spigot?** A: No. Spigot and CraftBukkit do not support client-side translations. For these platforms, item names will display in the server's default language. **Q: Does the Resource Pack conflict with other texture packs?** A: No. Because our pack uses the modern model system, it completely avoids overwriting vanilla items. This makes it highly compatible with other texture packs! --- ## 🛠️ Support & Community While all items are thoroughly tested, issues may still occur. * **Found a bug?** Please report it on our [GitHub Issue Tracker](https://github.com/mazurpiotr/pepeforge/issues). * **💡 Suggestions & Feedback:** Share your ideas in Pepe's Forge on Discord. * **💬 Community & Support:** Join us on Discord: [https://discord.gg/uPbSacDx4k](https://discord.gg/uPbSacDx4k) Every suggestion and bug report helps improve Pepe's Forge.
